text:
NSH::mocksf
Description
This command sets option to mock SF functionality for NSH.
Syntax
NSH
::
mocksf
Examples
Set the context for NSH.
# Set the mocksf option for NSH.
when
FLOW_INIT
{
NSH
::
mocksf
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
Introduced: BIGIP-13.1
